package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/targetcatalog"
)

const (
	targetResolutionRequestSchema  = "learning-target-resolution-request.v1"
	targetResolutionResponseSchema = "learning-target-resolution.v1"
	targetDiscoveryRequestSchema   = "learning-target-candidate-request.v1"
	targetDiscoveryResponseSchema  = "learning-target-candidates.v1"
)

type TargetCatalogHandler struct {
	Resolve  targetcatalog.Resolve
	Discover targetcatalog.Discover
}

type targetResolutionRequest struct {
	Schema  string             `json:"schema"`
	Targets []domain.TargetRef `json:"targets"`
}

type targetResolutionResponse struct {
	Schema   string             `json:"schema"`
	Resolved []domain.TargetRef `json:"resolved"`
	Missing  []domain.TargetRef `json:"missing"`
}

type targetDiscoveryRequest struct {
	Schema string   `json:"schema"`
	Stacks []string `json:"stacks"`
}

type targetDiscoveryResponse struct {
	Schema  string                            `json:"schema"`
	Targets []domain.LearningTargetDefinition `json:"targets"`
}

func (handler TargetCatalogHandler) ResolveExact(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(http.MaxBytesReader(writer, request.Body, 64<<10))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	var payload targetResolutionRequest
	if err := decoder.Decode(&payload); err != nil {
		writeTargetError(writer, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "invalid_request")
		return
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) || payload.Schema != targetResolutionRequestSchema {
		writeTargetError(writer, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "invalid_request")
		return
	}
	result, err := handler.Resolve.Handle(request.Context(), payload.Targets)
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
			writeTargetError(writer, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "invalid_request")
			return
		}
		writeTargetError(writer, http.StatusInternalServerError, "internal_error")
		return
	}
	writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(writer).Encode(targetResolutionResponse{
		Schema: targetResolutionResponseSchema, Resolved: result.Resolved, Missing: result.Missing,
	})
}

func (handler TargetCatalogHandler) DiscoverCandidates(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(http.MaxBytesReader(writer, request.Body, 64<<10))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	var payload targetDiscoveryRequest
	if err := decoder.Decode(&payload); err != nil {
		writeTargetError(writer, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "invalid_request")
		return
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) || payload.Schema != targetDiscoveryRequestSchema {
		writeTargetError(writer, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "invalid_request")
		return
	}
	result, err := handler.Discover.Handle(request.Context(), payload.Stacks)
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
			writeTargetError(writer, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "invalid_request")
			return
		}
		writeTargetError(writer, http.StatusInternalServerError, "internal_error")
		return
	}
	writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(writer).Encode(targetDiscoveryResponse{Schema: targetDiscoveryResponseSchema, Targets: result})
}

func writeTargetError(writer http.ResponseWriter, status int, code string) {
	writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	writer.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(writer).Encode(map[string]any{"error": map[string]string{"code": code}})
}
